summary: Employee expense reimbursement for visa fee stuck pending manual override / payment hold
related_confluence_pages: Confluence: Reimbursement Policy - Visa and Immigration Costs
description: Issue summary: Employee submitted an expense reimbursement (visa application fee) that appears as 'Pending - Manual Review' in the AP portal after approval. Impact: employee has incurred a time-sensitive visa payment and reimbursement is delayed pending a manual payment override. This is causing internal escalation to payroll and hiring team. Environment: Production finance workflow (SAP/Stripe payout integration) in us-east region. Steps to reproduce: 1) Employee submits expense with receipt and policy code VISA-IMM-01 in Concur. 2) Manager approves via Concur. 3) Expense sync job posts to AP queue and shows status 'Ready for Payment'. 4) Payment scheduled but flagged into 'Pending - Manual Review' with reason code: STUB_MISMATCH. Expected behavior: AP to issue payment in next vendor pay run and employee to receive reimbursement within SLAs. Actual behavior: AP hold prevents payment from being included in scheduled run; no automated notification sent to requester about required action. Logs/attachments: attached Concur submission ID CON-2026-04523, AP queue export CSV (attachment), screenshot of portal showing STUB_MISMATCH, payroll run log excerpt.
steps_to_reproduce: Submit an expense with policy code VISA-IMM-01 in Concur
Allow nightly sync job to post to AP queue
Observe AP portal row marked 'Pending - Manual Review' with reason STUB_MISMATCH
investigation_notes: 03/10 - Initial triage by finance: hold reason 'STUB_MISMATCH' typically indicates bank account metadata in Concur does not map to expected vendor remit fields.

03/11 - Verified Concur export: employee provided personal bank account; payment method set to 'Employee Reimbursement' which should be supported. No formatting anomalies in account number; bank country is 'GB' which requires BIC for our payout partner.

03/11 - Payment processor (FlyPay) returned field-level rejection code 1042: missing BIC/SWIFT for GBP direct credit; our mapping strips BIC when user selects 'UK' in legacy flow. Hypothesis: legacy Concur mapping omitted BIC causing STUB_MISMATCH.

03/12 - Reproduced case in staging by submitting a GBP reimbursement with no BIC: staging AP flagged identical STUB_MISMATCH. Confirmed code path in sync job that validates remit payload before scheduling payment.
comments: Aisha Rao (reporter) - 2026-03-10: Employee is on a critical timeline, asked if we can do a manual ACH/instant payout as an interim fix.
Diego Martinez (assignee) - 2026-03-11: Triage complete, leaving hold in place until confirmation from payment ops. Investigating mapping logic with Eng. Will escalate if manual payout needed.

Sara Lin (Payment Ops) - 2026-03-11: FlyPay support confirmed missing BIC is the blocker for GBP direct credits. For immediate remediation we can push payment as an on-demand wire with fees charged to department. Need approval from Finance Manager.
Matt O'Connell (Finance Manager) - 2026-03-12: Approved one-time wire for employee after verifying documents. Please proceed and capture cost center code HR-ONBOARD.

Diego Martinez - 2026-03-12: Per approval, initiated manual wire via FlyPay portal; recorded transaction ID FP-WIRE-78941 and attached confirmation. Follow-up: file a small enhancement ticket to Concur mapping to include BIC when country is UK.
Requester (employee) - 2026-03-12: Thanks — received payment confirmation this morning.
resolution_notes: 03/12 - Manual wire issued and cleared; employee reimbursed. Root cause: legacy Concur -> AP mapping omitted BIC/SWIFT for GBP reimbursements causing payment processor rejection and 'STUB_MISMATCH' hold. Fix plan: engineering change to Concur export mapping to include BIC when currency/country requires it (workaround already implemented in staging). Action items: (1) ENG to add mapping and deploy by 2026-03-19 (PR referenced), (2) FIN to run a backfilled query to find similar pending holds and remediate manually for active hiring queues, (3) update runbook for manual override and one-time wire approvals.
